description: List this tenant's triggers (optionally filtered by tool), each with next_unix, last_run_id and last_status (schedule), url/verify/unverified (event), or url/name/verify with no secret (webhook).

tenant_key.description: The key `signup` returned. Required only when this connection carries no Authorization: Bearer header -- when both are present, the header wins.

tool.description: Only triggers on this tool name.

name: host.trigger.list
